run_extract_features: run feature extraction on video data using a pre-trained Caffe2 model and save activations to pickle or h5
run_extract_features_gpus: run feature extraction on GPU devices with specified batch size and clip parameters
run_extract_features_rgb: run RGB video feature extraction with configurable clip length, sampling rate, and crop size
run_extract_features_flow: run optical flow feature extraction with configurable frame gap and flow data type
run_extract_features_sanity: run feature extraction with sanity check to verify clip accuracy or compute AUC metrics
